query:
SELECT id FROM runs
         WHERE status != 'Completed'
           AND placeholder = false
           AND updated_at < $1
           AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM jobs
                WHERE jobs.run_id = runs.id
                  AND jobs.status != 'Completed'
                  AND jobs.run_attempt >= runs.run_attempt
           )
         ORDER BY id
         LIMIT $2
